newsitem.title: USA: CompuCom sees rise in demand in second half.
newsitem.headline: CompuCom sees rise in demand in second half.

text.p: CompuCom Systems Inc said Monday that it expects product demand to increase in the second half of 1997.
CompuCom, which is a network integration company, said the increased demand was expected from companies upgrading to NT and Pentium II class hardware.

In addition, President and Chief Executive Ed Anderson said in a statement that "price reductions from manufacturers and their increased focus on controlling finished goods inventory levels should help close the price gap with direct marketers."
